IC1: Is between 18 and 40 years of age (inclusive)
IC2: Has had a self-reported visual exam in the last two years
IC3: Is an adapted Avaira sphere contact lens wearer (at least 1 week in Avaira sphere)
IC4: Has a contact lens spherical prescription between + 2.25 to - 8.00 (inclusive)
IC5: Has a spectacle cylinder up to 0.75D in each eye.
IC6: Can achieve best corrected spectacle distance visual acuity of 20/25 (0.10 logMAR) or better in each eye.
IC7: Can achieve a distance visual acuity [AND] of 20/30 (0.18 logMAR) or better in each eye with the study contact lenses.
IC8: Has clear corneas and [NOT] no active ocular disease
IC9: Has read, understood and signed the information consent letter.
IC10: Patient contact lens refraction should fit within the available parameters of the study lenses.
IC11: Is willing to comply with the wear schedule (at least 5 days per week, > 8 hours/day assuming there are no contraindications for doing so).
IC12: Is willing to comply with the visit schedule
